suggestions.quote: Your dentist will tell you which steps fit your situation.
suggestions.why: The phrase "your dentist" and similar hedges recur throughout the post, which reads as formulaic, templated AI prose.
suggestions.fix: Vary the wording and add one or two concrete, mainstream tips, such as using the next aligner tray on schedule or the usual timing of soreness after a new tray.
